examples: Keep the providers panel and add keep awake under it, so both are one glance away from the session list.
Show the providers in the full look, the one the home page uses, when the drawer is wide.
Place the providers widget in the glance area twice and pick a different account on each, so the glance row shows both accounts side by side.
Place the files widget in the glance area: its tile shows changed 5, or clean, for the session your terminal is on, and pressing it opens the area full.
how_to: Press edit layout at the bottom of the drawer.
Drag any row of the widget drawer's one list into the area, or press it to add it.
Use the strip above each widget to reorder it, switch its look between compact and full, or remove it.

Under the widgets, edit layout shows the glance area in yellow dashes: drag any row of the widget drawer's list into it; drag a glance's grip to reorder it, use its options to choose what it shows (the providers glance: which account), or remove it.
Press done to keep the arrangement; it follows you to every device.
Drag the thin handle above the area to move it between closed, glance (one row of small tiles) and full; while it is closed, click the small upward chevron to open it full.
Each tab remembers its own state on this device: agents and edit layout show it full, menu and questions at a glance.
Drag the line under a widget to make it taller or shorter for this visit.
media_exempt: the area is a list of existing widgets in the drawer, arranged in edit layout; its states are shown in the style guide's ledger section
name: Drawer widget area
summary: the area under every tab of the left sidebar is a list of widgets you arrange, with the providers panel in it by default; each tab remembers it full, at a glance, or closed. The glance row is its own glance area: widgets placed there separately, reordered among themselves, each placement with its own options (the providers glance names one account, so it can be placed once per account).
where: The area under every tab of the left sidebar, above the account bar, below its drag handle.
The widget drawer in edit layout: any row drops into the area.
The yellow-dashed glance area under the widgets while editing; any row of the widget drawer drops into it.
